can_do_vi: Kể một câu chuyện ngắn theo thứ tự: first, then, after that, finally
Nghe hiểu và kể lại truyện cổ tích ngắn
grammar_note_vi: Kể chuyện theo thứ tự dùng: First (Đầu tiên), Then (Rồi), After that (Sau đó), Finally (Cuối cùng). Truyện cổ tích hay mở đầu bằng "Once upon a time..." (Ngày xửa ngày xưa...).

The king lives in a big castle.
The prince has a white horse.

text_en: Once upon a time, there was a poor girl called Hoa.
She lived near a big forest.
One day, she heard a strange noise.
Hoa was afraid, but she was brave.
She asked him what was wrong.
He said that he lost his little dog.
Finally, she found the dog under a tree.
He gave Hoa a bag of gold.
After that, they were best friends, and they lived happily ever after.

questions.q: Where did Hoa find the dog?
What did the giant give Hoa?
